- High angle (고각도): Shows the subject from above, creating a sense of vulnerability or inferiority; benefits include creating a sense of power dynamics and emphasizing the environment; used in action scenes and establishing shots in film.
- Low angle (저각도): Shows the subject from below, creating a sense of power or superiority; benefits include creating a sense of power dynamics and emphasizing the subject; used in hero shots and establishing shots in film.
- Dutch angle (디트취): Shows the scene at an angle, creating a sense of unease or tension; benefits include creating a sense of distortion and imbalance; used in horror movies and action scenes.
- Worm's eye view (지렁이시점): Shows the subject from a very low angle, creating a sense of grandeur or drama; benefits include emphasizing the subject's power or importance; used in hero shots and establishing shots in film.
- Aerial shot (공중촬영): Shows the scene from a high altitude, providing an overview of the environment; benefits include providing context and scale; used in landscape photography and establishing shots in film.
- Crane shot (크레인샷): Shows the scene from a moving crane, creating a sense of dynamism or movement; benefits include providing a unique perspective; used in action scenes and music videos.
- Steadicam shot (스테디캠): Shows the scene with a camera mounted on a stabilizing rig, creating a smooth and stable shot; benefits include creating a sense of fluidity and stability; used in action scenes and documentary filmmaking.
- Handheld shot (핸드헬드): Shows the scene with a handheld camera, creating a sense of immediacy or chaos; benefits include creating a sense of realism and intimacy; used in mockumentaries and found footage films.
- Tilt shot (틸트샷): Shows the scene at a diagonal angle, creating a sense of instability or tension; benefits include creating a sense of distortion and imbalance; used in horror movies and action scenes.
- Pan shot (팬샷): Shows the scene with a horizontal movement of the camera, creating a sense of continuity and movement; benefits include emphasizing the environment; used in travel videos and nature documentaries.
- Zoom shot (줌샷): Shows the scene with a change in focal length of the camera, creating a sense of intimacy or tension; benefits include creating a sense of focus and intimacy; used in music videos and romantic comedies.
